limitations: Additive custom configuration validation only; no pre-existing native Codex subsystem was extracted.

The 10 tests ran before mechanical formatting. No post-format rerun is claimed; the two changed files were reviewed and predicates/literals/assertions were unchanged.
Frozen stage manifest status staged_uncompiled is historical; completed evidence is these terminal reports. Wrapper baseline is metadata, not a clean-commit assertion.
